description: AdaptiveWindow 0.4.4 separates native-sized inventory icons (64x64 RGBA) from the unchanged held-model textures (128x128), reusing all 21 existing previews. Built and installed against Hytale 0.7.2.
changes: Resize only Icons/ItemsGenerated PNGs to 64x64; preserve Items textures and UVs
Bump plugin and generated cache to 0.4.4 so next startup refreshes existing saves with backup
Retarget manifest and compile against installed Hytale 0.7.2
Assert 64px inventory dimensions separately from 128px held dimensions
advantages: Minimal asset-only display correction with no new illustration cost
All 245 non-icon/non-manifest pack entries byte-identical to 0.4.3
All 21 distinct window silhouettes retained including original and rose
disadvantages: Final visual confirmation in the user client is pending; native server checks do not prove GPU rendering
test_results: All 4533 native ItemsGenerated PNGs in installed Assets.zip are 64x64; previous 21 window icons were 128x128
Native Hytale 0.7.2 isolated create test: 7315 checks passed
Cache migrated from 0.4.3 to 0.4.4; all 21 icon PNGs verified 64x64 after native startup
Installed shared JAR SHA256 cda9140c3f906a922404af3b697ad9949f230d6c4e677936b7fdab6a91232ea6; four other mods unchanged; no user world opened
